example.title: Alexander Paul Store, Main & North Streets
example.source: HABS WI-289 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,22-PAGROVI,1-)

brief: Two-storey vernacular Romanesque Revival brick store designed and built in 1859 by Alexander Paul, later a bowling alley, furniture store and funeral parlour. Round-arched upper windows with brick hoods, a stepped and curved parapet carrying a lettered name panel, and three wide round-arched shop openings with wood frames on the ground floor; stands alone on a rough lot beside a village street.
